$comment: Orchestra task board. Claude Code is the conductor; codex exec runs are the players. See orchestra/README.md.

tasks.title: Fix outstanding ESLint warnings
tasks.prompt: Run `npm run lint` and fix every warning it reports. Do not change behaviour: only rename, reorder, or annotate. Re-run lint until it is clean.

tasks.title: Make the vitest suite green
tasks.prompt: Run `npm run test`. For each failing test, read the test and the code under test, then fix the code (not the test) unless the test itself encodes a wrong expectation. Explain any test you change.
